subject.title: [Feature]: Support for sandbox Docker parameters (--gpus all, --ipc=host)

question: Should OpenClaw expose host IPC for Docker sandboxes, and if yes should it be a narrow explicit `sandbox.docker.ipc` break-glass field rather than raw Docker argument passthrough?
rationale: The remaining request changes the sandbox isolation boundary and public config contract, while current main already solves GPU passthrough through a typed field.

options.title: Add narrow host IPC field
options.body: Add an explicit opt-in IPC setting with schema, docs, config hashing, create-args tests, and security-audit coverage while keeping raw Docker args unsupported.

options.title: Reject host IPC in core
options.body: Document that host IPC weakens sandbox isolation and keep GPU passthrough as the supported high-power Docker path.

options.title: Design broader namespace policy
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define a consistent policy for IPC, PID, network namespace joins, capabilities, and other dangerous Docker options.

recommendation.title: Add narrow host IPC field
recommendation.body: Add an explicit opt-in IPC setting with schema, docs, config hashing, create-args tests, and security-audit coverage while keeping raw Docker args unsupported.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent sandbox namespace-sharing hardening and are the strongest current-history match for the security-boundary decision.
